brief_summary: This was a 24-week single-center, open-label, parallel controlled group comparing gliclazide, liraglutide, and metformin effects on diabetes with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease.

lead_sponsor.name: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School

official_title: Comparison of Efficacy of Liraglutide, Metformin and Gliclazide MR on Hepatic Lipid Content in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes (T2DM) and Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver (NAFLD)

sites.facility: at Division of Endocrinology, the Affiliated Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University
